posts.zh:
TokenLedger 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。侧边栏用量面板：把 Token 归属到实际服务该请求的中转站，站点从已有的 provider 配置中读出，无需额外配置；含今日/本月/累计三窗口、按站点与模型下钻、一年活跃度热力图，以及 New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek 余额。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2b39ccf707df309d872f.html
posts.en:
TokenLedger is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Sidebar usage panel that attributes tokens to the relay site that served each request, read from your existing provider config: today/month/all-time totals, per-site and per-model breakdowns, a year activity heatmap, and New API / Sub2API / DeepSeek balances.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-2b39ccf707df309d872f.html
